title: Hold a petroleum title to explore for or recover petroleum offshore
what: Exploring for petroleum in a Commonwealth offshore area needs a petroleum exploration permit or other authority under the Act.

laws.title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Act 2006

sources.title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Act 2006
sources.quote: 97 Prohibition of unauthorised exploration for petroleum in offshore area (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person explores for petroleum; and (b) the exploration occurs in an offshore area.

reach.condition: if it explores for or recovers petroleum in an offshore area
